test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Loose cannon

options.text: Someone who is enthusiastic and very eager to take responsibilities.
Someone who is well known and respected in society
Someone who is quiet and reserved in social situations
Someone who is unpredictable and liable to cause problems

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Someone who is unpredictable and liable to cause problems. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Loose cannon"** means someone who is unpredictable and likely to cause problems or damage. (अप्रत्याशित और समस्याएं उत्पन्न करने वाला) • **Example:** John's unpredictable behavior at meetings makes him a loose cannon on the team. • **"Unpredictable"** refers to someone or something that cannot be predicted; they may act in unexpected ways. (अप्रत्याशित) • **Example:** The weather in this region is highly unpredictable. • Hence, we can infer that "Loose cannon" describes someone who is unpredictable and liable to cause problems. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Someone who is unpredictable and liable to cause problems. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Someone who is enthusiastic and very eager to take responsibilities** (कोई जो उत्साही और जिम्मेदारियां लेने के लिए बहुत उत्सुक हो): • **Example:** She is always the first to volunteer for new projects, very enthusiastic and eager to take on responsibilities. • **Someone who is well known and respected in society** (कोई जो समाज में प्रसिद्ध और सम्मानित हो): • **Example:** The mayor is a well-known and respected figure in our community. • **Someone who is quiet and reserved in social situations** (कोई जो सामाजिक स्थितियों में शांत और संयमी हो): • **Example:** Despite his talent, he's often quiet and reserved at social gatherings. 17b:Tb94, The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Joy and sorrow.
